versions.changelog:
Initial release of the product-ux-audit skill.

- Provides structured, read-only audits of product logic, UX heuristics, user flows, edge cases, and modularity.
- Audits are scoped to a single user flow or module per invocation; never audit the entire codebase at once.
- Uses evidence-based findings anchored to specific files/lines/screens; avoids generic or unactionable recommendations.
- Outputs reports only (no repo modifications), separating product/UX concerns from security/code-quality.
- Follows a rigorous, multi-phase process for consistent, actionable audit results.
